declaration_model.observation: Capability status is currently distributed across Current projections, manifests and domain authorities. There is no single canonical AI-facing operation registry that binds public operation, inputs, outputs, authority, mode, status, validator and claim ceiling.

required_questions.q1_current_bounded_deferred_reference_hi: The census above preserves Current, Current-bounded, Owner-deferred, reference-only and historical states without promoting implementation or past tests into public capability.
required_questions.q2_where_declared: Machine Current authorities establish identity and lifecycle; Pack manifests and runtime surfaces declare bounded routes and permissions; domain documents establish operation-specific semantics; migration and evolution surfaces resolve historical provenance.
required_questions.q3_existing_ai_cold_start_scope: The cold start restores what Ignition is, its Current state and boundaries, what to read, and where special authority lives. It does not define the default meaning of a repository URL plus user object, select an execution mode, resolve a public operation or specify a common result contract.
required_questions.q4_existing_iteration_scope: ITERATION.md governs state-changing work on Ignition itself: remote truth, gap and claim ceiling, propagation, synchronization, validation, review, merge and Current receipts. It is not the general protocol for using Ignition on external input.
q5_missing_link_plus_object_protocol: No authoritative default says a repository URL is an operating-method source rather than repository-mutation authorization.
No authoritative default classifies an attached Markdown, PDF, note, webpage or code artifact as INPUT_OBJECT rather than executable instruction.
No common mode gate distinguishes read-only use, repository change and externally authorized action before tools are selected.
No canonical operation registry binds accepted inputs, outputs, Current status, minimal reads, authority, mutation permission, validator and claim ceiling.
No common lifecycle connects request acceptance, Current freeze, operation resolution, canonical collision or evidence checks, adversarial review and bounded rendering.
No common output contract separates source content, existing canonical assets, new increment, conflicts, unknowns and candidates.

reviewed_nearby_surfaces.not_equivalent_reason: Guides a human to ask an AI to read the repository; it does not govern an Agent run over an arbitrary input object.
Explains navigation, layers, governance and change propagation; it does not expose a mode classifier, operation registry or common run contract.
Lists reading entrances and authorities; it is not an execution protocol.
Its explicit scope is how Ignition changes itself.

q6_authority_collision_check.conclusion: No duplicate canonical authority was found. The missing use-layer protocol must remain distinct from the Iteration Method and must reuse, not replace, Current machine and domain authorities.

prohibited_inferences: No implementation, historical case, merged file or passing test is promoted to a Current public operation solely by presence.
No Pack manifest grants generic runtime, network, remote Git, Owner, truth or epistemic authority.
No live external process is authorized or started by this audit.
No new architecture component, layer or operating-method design is established by this audit.
